description: Vendor client-side revenue PDF export on the dashboard. Pin jspdf 2.5.2 + jspdf-autotable 3.8.4 (exact versions), add a canonical placedAt to the Dashboard done bucket so every completed row groups by its real calendar day, create the pure src/lib/revenuePdf.js (aggregateByDay + buildRevenuePdf), and wire an 'Export PDF' button into DashboardTab. Vendor-scoped via existing owner RLS on orders; no new server endpoint. Independent of FEAT-001; corresponds to plan.md items 6-9. Note: the placedAt addition to the done bucket (step 2) is also relied on by nothing else, but keep it minimal and additive.
steps: package.json: add to dependencies, EXACT versions (no caret): "jspdf": "2.5.2" and "jspdf-autotable": "3.8.4". Then run npm install.

Dashboard.jsx loadOrders: add placedAt: Date.parse(o.placed_at) to the done.push mapping (live.push already has it); keep daysAgo on done rows for the existing history grouping and range filter. This gives every completed row in allHistory a canonical placedAt.

Create src/lib/revenuePdf.js: export aggregateByDay(orders) keyed by new Date(placedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-PH') (named export, DOM-free) and buildRevenuePdf({ storeName, rangeLabel, generatedAt, days, grandTotal, orderCount }) returning a jsPDF doc — header with store name, 'Revenue report', range label, generatedAt, and a 'Day boundary: your device's local time' line; autoTable columns [Date, Completed orders, Revenue (PHP)]; a summary row for orderCount + grandTotal. Print amounts as 'PHP 1,234.00' via toLocaleString('en-PH') (no peso glyph). Empty range -> a single 'No completed orders in this range' line + zero total, never throw.

Dashboard.jsx DashboardTab: add an 'Export PDF' button in the toolbar styled dashboard-btn dashboard-btn--outline with the download icon. Handler: take the in-range completed orders, build days via aggregateByDay keyed by each order's placedAt, call buildRevenuePdf(...), doc.save('revenue-' + range + '.pdf'), flash('Revenue report downloaded'); wrap in try/catch -> flash('Could not generate the PDF. Please try again.') + console.error. Leave the existing CSV exportReport in AccountTab untouched.
acceptance_criteria: package.json pins jspdf 2.5.2 and jspdf-autotable 3.8.4 exactly (no caret/range).
`npm install` resolves both at the pinned versions; `npm run build` succeeds.
Every completed row carries a canonical placedAt; the PDF groups orders by their real calendar day (not 'days ago') and prints the day-boundary basis.
Revenue counts completed orders only; the grand total equals the sum of in-range completed order totals; an empty range yields a valid zero-total PDF.
buildRevenuePdf and aggregateByDay are pure/DOM-free named exports; the CSV export still works.

findings:
DEPS: package.json dependencies now pin "jspdf": "2.5.2" and "jspdf-autotable": "3.8.4" EXACTLY (no caret), inserted alphabetically after @supabase/supabase-js. `npm install` resolved them (jspdf-autotable 3.8.4 -> jspdf 2.5.2 deduped); `npm ls jspdf jspdf-autotable` shows 2.5.2 and 3.8.4. Build pulls in html2canvas + dompurify as jspdf's optional deps (separate chunks, build still OK). FEAT-003's OrderStatus screenshot upload path is unaffected by this.

placedAt: Dashboard.jsx loadOrders done.push now carries `placedAt: Date.parse(o.placed_at)` alongside the existing daysAgo (kept for the history grouping + range filter). The live.push already had placedAt, and allHistory's first spread is `orders.filter(completed).map(daysAgo:0)` (live rows, which have placedAt), so EVERY row in allHistory now carries a canonical placedAt. Minimal/additive — no other consumer relies on it.

revenuePdf.js: new src/lib/revenuePdf.js is pure/DOM-free. `aggregateByDay(orders)` groups by `new Date(placedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-PH')` and returns { days (oldest-first, each {date,orderCount,revenue}), grandTotal, orderCount }. `buildRevenuePdf({storeName,rangeLabel,generatedAt,days,grandTotal,orderCount})` returns a jsPDF doc: header (store name + 'Revenue report'), meta lines (range, generated, "Day boundary: your device's local time"), jspdf-autotable table [Date, Completed orders, Revenue (PHP)] with a foot Total row. Amounts formatted 'PHP 1,234.00' via toLocaleString('en-PH', 2 decimals) — NO peso glyph (core PDF fonts lack it). Empty days -> single 'No completed orders in this range' line + PHP 0.00 total, never throws. Palette ORANGE [234,88,12] head fill + light-orange [255,237,213] foot; no blue.

WIRING: DashboardTab now takes (history, storeName, flash). Export handler `exportPdf` builds days from `done` (the in-range COMPLETED orders already computed for the KPIs), uses RANGES.find(id).label as rangeLabel, saves `revenue-<range>.pdf`, flashes 'Revenue report downloaded'; try/catch -> console.error + flash('Could not generate the PDF. Please try again.'). Button is in the PageHead actions slot (the page toolbar), styled `dashboard-btn dashboard-btn--outline` with the existing `download` Icon. Call site passes storeName={vendor?.name ?? 'Store'} flash={flash}. The AccountTab CSV exportReport is untouched. Grand total = sum of in-range completed order totals (same `done` set as the revenue KPI).
